blocks.html: This method is used to upload a file

types.name: file
types.description:
The contents and metadata of the file.
Among the file’s details, you can access the file’s path in the `path` property of the file object.

children.name: filename
children.description: The filename of the uploaded file

children.name: mimeType
children.description: The mimetype of the uploaded file

children.name: content
children.description: The file content as a base64-encoded string

children.name: access
children.description: The access level of the file. Defaults to private if not passed

types.name: Promise
types.description: The details of the upload's result.

children.name: url
children.description:
The file's URL that users or systems
can use to access the file.

children.name: key
children.description:
The file's key allowing you to later
identify the file in the third-party
system. For example, the S3 Module Provider
returns the file's key in S3, whereas the
Local File Module Provider returns the file's
path.

blocks.html: This method is used to delete one or more files from the storage

types.name: fileData
types.description: The details of the files to remove.

children.name: fileKey
children.description:
The file's key. When uploading a file, the
returned key is used here.

types.name: Promise
types.description: Resolves when the file is deleted successfully.

blocks.html:
This method is used to retrieve a download URL of the file. For some file services, such as S3, a presigned URL indicates a temporary URL to get access to a file.

If your file service doesn’t perform or offer a similar functionality, you can just return the URL to download the file.

children.name: fileKey
children.description:
The file's key allowing you to later
identify the file in the third-party
system. For example, the S3 Module Provider
returns the file's key in S3, whereas the
Local File Module Provider returns the file's
path.

types.name: Promise
types.description: The presigned URL to download the file

blocks.html:
This method is used to get a presigned upload URL for a file. For some providers,
such as S3, a presigned URL indicates a temporary URL to get upload a file.

If your provider doesn’t perform or offer a similar functionality, you don't have to
implement this method. Instead, an error is thrown when the method is called.

types.name: fileData
types.description: The details of the file to get a presigned upload URL for.

children.name: filename
children.description: The filename of the file to get a presigned upload URL for.

children.name: mimeType
children.description: The mimetype of the file to get a presigned upload URL for.

children.name: access
children.description: The access level of the file to get a presigned upload URL for.

children.name: expiresIn
children.description: The validity of the presigned upload URL in seconds.

types.name: Promise
types.description: The presigned URL and file key to upload the file to
